evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Domain jargon (rollback, rehearsed) used natively, then crystallized into a plain-spoken aphorism — the register signature of operational maxims stated in the org's own pipeline vocabulary.
